ns2:section.sectionText: GEOL 110 centers around two geology field trips: a 2.5-day trip to the beautiful St. Francois Mountains in southeast Missouri and a 1-day trip to the dramatic cliffs of Starved Rock Park in north-central Illinois. These trips are always memorable and fun and they present great ways to get to know other students, the instructor, and geology, in general. After these trips, rock outcrops never again are featureless walls, but are picture books of Earth history. Classroom meetings cover essentials necessary to understand the geology of the two field trip locations. Course will meet through the end of October.
